record.notes: Sources disagree on whether the 3,000 credits are monthly or one-time: one review says monthly, two say one-time, and the vendor page does not render the free card at all. Classified as one-time because that is the majority and the more conservative reading. The credit-to-dollar rate is the vendor's, which makes this the only app builder in evaluated offerings that publishes its exchange rate.
